text: "They are the sons of [worthless and nameless] fools, They have been driven out of the land.
"Terrors are turned upon me; They chase away my honor and reputation like the wind, And my prosperity has passed away like a cloud.
"For I know that You will bring me to death And to the house of meeting [appointed] for all the living.
"Therefore my lyre (harp) is used for [the sound of] mourning, And my flute for the [sound of the] voices of those who weep.
